partners.name: The BioFi Project
partners.place: Southern Blue Ridge Mountains of Appalachia, working across the Americas
partners.text: A think-and-do tank partnering with communities to build place-based economies that regenerate, rather than deplete, the ecological and social systems they are part of. Home of Bioregional Financing Facilities, a growing resource library and monthly Deep Dives.

partners.name: Unearthodox
partners.place: Versoix, near Geneva, Switzerland, working worldwide
partners.text: Grown from the legacy of the Luc Hoffmann Institute, Unearthodox drives systems change through social innovation, so that nature and people can thrive together. It supports edge-walking innovators through its Exploration Co-Lab, rethinks innovation with the Post Growth Institute, and shares essays from the people it convenes in its Deep Dives.

partners.name: Becoming Crew
partners.place: England, with gatherings on the land near Bath and online
partners.text: An action learning collective guiding Earth-centred learning journeys and gatherings, in service to life: connection, cooperation and creativity, lived through ongoing practice. Home of The Spaceship Earth Podcast, hosted by Dan Burgess.

partners.name: Regenesis Institute for Regenerative Practice
partners.place: Santa Fe, New Mexico, with cohorts around the world
partners.text: Education and support for practitioners of regenerative development: bringing human activity back into alignment with the living systems that sustain it, by understanding the uniqueness of each place.

partners.name: Post Growth Institute
partners.text: Exploring a just and livable world beyond capitalism, and nurturing ideas, programmes and alliances that help money, power and resources circulate in local communities and the global economy.

partners.name: Hometree
partners.text: Restoring native woodland and temperate rainforest in the west of Ireland.

partners.name: Bioregional Learning Centre
partners.text: Bioregioning and learning journeys toward a resilient region.

partners.name: Good Grief Network
partners.text: Peer support for people overwhelmed by the state of the world.

partners.name: Regenerative Communities Network
partners.founder: Convened by Capital Institute, now run by its members

partners.name: Transition Network
partners.text: Local groups working on food, energy, repair and community.

partners.name: Siendo Naturaleza
partners.text: A learning centre for land-based learning and regeneration, with short courses in regenerative agriculture, systems thinking and deep ecology.
partners.founder: Founded by Eliane Cohen, a Schumacher College alumna and a longtime collaborator of IRB

partners.name: Third Horizon Earth
partners.text: A nonpartisan knowledge and practice platform connecting regenerative pioneers to accelerate regenerative development.

partners.name: The Emergence Network
partners.text: A planetary network of care and inquiry, exploring postactivism and making sanctuary.

partners.name: Institute for Practical ekoPhilosophy
partners.text: Philosophy as a practical response to the crises of our time: PhilosophyGyms and the Life as Lab Fellowship.
partners.founder: Founded and led by Dr Jessica Böhme

partners.name: Dark Matter Labs
partners.text: Optionality, risk-in capital and bioregional finance.
